record.title: Evaluate the first signal and the next integration question
record.intent: Choose the next bounded RF preparation step from the actual signal evidence.
requirements: Distinguish source command acceptance, observed frequency and amplitude, export readiness and unresolved source accuracy. Do not equate a displayed waveform with 1 GHz characterization.
Reconcile the pilot result with the existing RF-response inventory and integration tasks; identify the exact next measurement or tooling gap rather than expanding the completed run.
Commit and push the evaluation. No physical operation occurs in this decision task.
acceptance: The first signal has a scoped disposition and an evidence-based next step.
